verdict.rationale: The evidence describes number provisioning, porting, and assignment only through the Admin console UI. The only API cited is the Workspace Reports activities list, which retrieves activity logs and does not search, buy, or configure numbers. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a documented number-provisioning API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, buy, and configure phone numbers through a documented API
